entities.summary: Riau, a notable figure in the history of Malaysia, associated with Successor Sultanates and European Rivalry (1511–1699). Preceded by Johor Sultanate. Their legacy influenced Dutch capture Malacca from the Portuguese with Johor's help and Anglo-Dutch Treaty.
